title: Excluding-Australia cumulative expected shortfall in constant dollars
limitations: Historical input provenance is incomplete; inspection only; the assessment is not recomputable.
The tail shortfall measure applies to the positive part of revenue loss, whereas the mean loss estimate is signed; these are not directly comparable.
The measure covers agriculture, forestry and fishing value added and conditional government revenue transmission, not total-economy loss, and is not a sovereign default probability.
Price and exchange-rate responses are not modeled; values are in constant 2025 USD at a fixed 2025 exchange rate.
Official forecasts used are marginal, not joint, and the extension is not a NOAA forecast; historical validation is conditional and does not establish causal identification.
